messages:
Asha: Heads up — we're running 7 minutes late, mic on stage 2 is acting up. Can someone confirm we still want to start with roadmap or move CEO intro to later? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Eli: I'm on my way to the AV room. If we can't fix mic in 5, let's swap order — move roadmap first, CEO after Q&A.
Sam Ops: AV says the XLR feed is dropping. Rae, can you check the backup mic kit?
Rae: On it. Recorder also threw a disk full error earlier. Trying to free space, but might need manual recording fallback.
Priya: If recorder fails, we can do local OBS capture on my laptop and upload after — I have 1TB free. Sam Ops can you switch RTMP to `rtmp://backup.redwood.live/stream2`?
Sam Ops: switching now. will post confirmation.
infra-bot: RTMP switch initiated by Sam Ops at 2026-03-23T15:12:05Z
Sam Ops: switched :white_check_mark: please test audio from remote presenter (Zach) — his feed is on call-in line 3.
Asha: @Zach can you unmute and do a quick mic check? we may need to do speakerphone fallback.
Zach (guest): testing 1 2 3, can hear stage, my audio is low. Using headset now.
Eli: If guest audio is low, route him through mixer channel B and bump gain +6dB.
Rae: Mixer gain bumped. Zach now audible in our headphones but still a smidge low for stream.
Sam Ops: applying a compressor in OBS to even levels.
Priya: I'm starting local OBS record at 1080p/30fps. filename: allhands_local_priya_1777777777.mkv
Asha: thank you. Q&A — we'll hold first 5 minutes for clarifying roadmap bullets, then open to live questions. Folks, please DM me any leadership questions you want asked.
Eli: Quick note for speakers: timebox slides to 6 minutes each. Leaders, we'll keep live demos to a single short demo or fall back to screenshots.
Rae: Recorder freed 8GB by clearing temp; will keep an eye on disk usage. if it fills, we cut to local record.
Sam Ops: clip ops — @marketing, please stand by to grab highlight clips. Use `OBS > Studio Mode > Create marker` so we can find points.
Priya: Uploaded marker when CEO starts. Will share exact timestamp after finish.
Asha: Also, post-allhands follow-ups: 1) roadmaps deck link 2) list of open Qs 3) clip requests form. I'll post threads.
Eli: For next time, add a preflight checklist item: verify recorder free space >= 30GB and backup RTMP set.
Asha: Agreed. Thanks all — we're green for starting in 3. I'll ping again at go.
Sam Ops: go live in 2 minutes. :film_projector:
Asha: Live in 30s. :raised_hands:
infra-bot: Stream health: OK, ingest jitter 12ms, bitrate 4.2Mbps
Asha: Start the roadmap now. Keep Qs short and tag leads. I'll collect unanswered Qs and route to leadership.
Priya: local recording running, backup RTMP live, OBS compressor on, markers enabled.
Rae: Audio levels stable now. :thumbsup:
Eli: Noted action items: add recorder check to runbook, update slide timeboxes, post Q&A summary after.
Asha: thanks everyone — tagging participants for follow-up: @Eli @Rae @Priya @Sam Ops
